figma.source: TEXT node box width (Figma rounds the hug text box up to whole pixels)

browser.source: identical glyph ink; Chromium keeps the fractional advance (Inter 3.19, 14px/600)

exceptions.reason: Glyph ink is pixel-identical between Figma and Chromium (verified by column ink profile); Figma's integer text box is 0.64px wider, which shifts the trailing icon 1px. Pinned in the specimen harness only (specimen.html) so the component keeps no magic constants.
exceptions.permanentFix: text-measurement utility that rounds the label box like Figma, or accept <=1px geometry tolerance

figma.value: underline row 3-4px below the glyph baseline
figma.source: measured from reference export (Figma API exposes no underline metric)

browser.value: Chromium places it from the font's own underline position

exceptions.reason: Figma stores the hover underline as a character-level textDecoration override (styleOverrideTable) with no offset; the two renderers position it differently. Measured per size by visual/calibrate-underline.mjs and emitted as text-underline-offset.
exceptions.permanentFix: re-measure after a font or renderer change: node visual/calibrate-underline.mjs --force

browser.value: Chromium approximates shadow corners from the border radius

exceptions.reason: CSS box-shadow spread does not reproduce Figma's exact corner geometry at 4px spread; residual is a 1-2px arc difference on the focus ring.
exceptions.permanentFix: draw focus rings with an explicit pseudo-element rounded rect when a future specimen needs sub-pixel ring fidelity

browser.value: track + arc rendered from normalised 16-unit paths

exceptions.reason: Tail of the matrix: these 3-5 variants remain the only ones above the 3% perceptual outlier threshold (track/arc rasterisation on a 32-48px square).
exceptions.permanentFix: compare the spinner at the ellipse's native scale or export a dedicated spinner reference
